metadata.title: Monochromatic Hip-Hop Portrait with Block Header

retrievalProfile.description: A centered, high-contrast monochrome portrait framed by a heavy black header bar containing bold, negative-space display typography.
excludeWhen: clean, high-resolution digital photography without grain is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a grainy, sepia-toned or desaturated monochrome portrait of a subject in a textured garment, topped by a solid black rectangular banner containing thick, sans-serif lettering that interacts with a hand-drawn graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the solid black header and the textured portrait background
Textural contrast between the subject's skin and the coarse, curly texture of the fur-like garment
Geometric tension between the rigid block lettering and the organic, hand-drawn smiley face overlay
coreInvariants: Solid black header bar spanning the full width
Heavy grain or halftone screen effect across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, subject occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid black header bar at the top acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text in the header, move down to the subject's face, and then follow the texture of the garment to the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The background behind the subject is a flat, textured light tone, providing breathing room around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white for the background and text highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the header bar and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for the photographic grain and garment textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the black header and light background.
paletteRestrictions: No pure white; use aged paper or cream tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is modified with a hand-drawn, thin-line smiley face overlay featuring 'X' eyes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface paired with a hand-drawn illustrative element.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric structure.
Offers a similar heavy, blocky presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered monochrome portrait of a man with a beard wearing a textured curly fur coat against a light, grainy background. Add a solid black bar across the top 25% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold, cream-colored uppercase sans-serif text inside the black bar. Overlay a thin, hand-drawn smiley face with 'X' eyes onto one of the circular letters.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained entirely within the black header bar?
Is the overall image monochromatic with a grainy, film-like texture?
Is the typography extra-bold and tightly spaced?
Does the subject's garment show high tactile texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any existing brand logos or parental advisory stickers

mustAchieve: Consistent film grain across all elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the tight kerning.
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the black header is perfectly horizontal and flush to edges.
Confirm the hand-drawn element looks like a thin-line overlay, not part of the font.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-texture portrait, desaturate it, add a heavy black header bar, and knock out bold geometric type from that bar.
